title: Acronyms used in the DPI-H reference architecture
description: The RA's acronyms list, read verbatim from its acronyms table: one SKOS concept per acronym, the acronym as its notation and the expansion as printed as its prefLabel. The acronyms table is drawn from this file (Tool glossary-table, litlfred/smart-ra#206). Every term is a candidate: only a person adopts a definition, and the definitions of the concepts that have one are in dpi-h-ra.glossary.json.
